estimation_procedure.description: One full-sample OLS regression of one-year-ahead PTBI on current PTBI, the LNBTD and LPBTD indicators, and the two PTBI-by-indicator interactions. The indicators permit the intercept and PTBI slope to differ for the large-BTD groups; SmallBTD is the reference group. This is one interacted fit over the full 14,106-firm-year sample, not separate regressions by BTD group.

evidence.quote: To test whether firm-years with large negative (positive) book-tax differences have lower earnings persistence, I estimate Equation (2), which permits the coefficient on earnings to vary depending on the level of the book-tax differences by introducing an indicator variable for each of the large book-tax difference subsamples.
The final group consists of the remaining firm-years—those with relatively small scaled book-tax differences—which I label SmallBTD.

preprocessing.description: PTBI and scaled temporary book-tax differences are scaled by average total assets; LNBTD and LPBTD are binary group indicators and are not asset-scaled. All financial-statement variables are winsorized (reset) at the 1st and 99th percentiles.
